itens.de: For the thousand or so residents of Balboa born in the Zone, the rule was the same: they were citizens if a parent had been one at the time of the birth. So the law that ran the ground left citizenship to the parents.
itens.para: So for the thousand or so residents of Balboa born in the Zone, the answer came from their parents, not from where they were born.
